high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The content of the article discusses a case involving two brothers who were accused of swindling money from people over several years with the promise of doubling their investments within 12 months. Initially, the promised payments were made, but later, they began to default on these promises. Some individuals who asked for their money back were threatened.
